## What changed

- Federation now runs external knowledge stores listed under `knowledge_stores` in the user's `lat` config (`lat paths --config`), never from a repository config. Includes a `codebase-memory-mcp` adapter (`dist/src/fork/adapters/codebase-memory-store.js`) for symbol search and caller lookups.
- When a callers store is registered, federation lists who calls the source symbols a surfaced document links, the Stop reminder notes unreviewed sections linked to callers of changed code, and `lat impact --callers` adds caller-linked sections to the impact walk.
- Federation caps total hits shown per prompt at 9, records per-store timings and hit counts as `federate:<store>` usage events when tracking is enabled, and filters hits against the prompt through a decision model when `LAT_FEDERATION_RERANK_URL` is set. Every external call fails open.
- Claude Code's `PostToolUse` hook now fires after `Read`, naming `@lat:` targets in the read range once per session and advising the agent to run `lat section` and `lat refs` before editing. Run `lat init` again in existing projects to add the `Read` hook entry; the fork's `AGENTS.md` and `GEMINI.md` conventions also gain this rule.
- New `lat resolve <ref>` command prints `{"file","line"}` as JSON for the section, source symbol, or path a wiki link opens.
- New VS Code extension in `packages/vscode-wiki-links` (`pnpm --filter vscode-wiki-links package`) makes `[[wiki links]]` in `@lat:` comments and `lat.md/` files clickable in trusted workspaces.
